title: Tenant spike gate and soft-quarantine orchestration
author: Priya Rao
release_notes: Adds tenant-level probabilistic admission gate and soft-quarantine orchestration to reduce cross-tenant cascade during regional spikes; safe feature-flagged rollout.
body: Motivation: Production incidents showed a single tenant spike can cascade through regional nodes and force SLO-driven evictions that impact other tenants. Existing circuit breakers operate at node/region level and are too coarse. This PR implements a tenant-level, lease-based soft-quarantine and a probabilistic admission gate to contain noisy tenants while preserving cluster-wide SLOs. Design summary: 1) Probabilistic admission gate: computes a moving percentile estimator (configurable window) of recent per-tenant latency and uses a probability function to early-reject or defer low-priority requests when a tenant exceeds configured thresholds. This reduces peak load without immediate hard-eviction. 2) Soft-quarantine orchestration: a short-duration lease (default 30s with exponential backoff) marks a tenant as degraded; new requests are routed to a lightpath (lower-cost model / reduced decoding length) and given lower concurrency. The lease is leadership-managed so multiple routers enforce a consistent view. 3) KV cache drain smoothing: when a tenant enters quarantine, its KV entries are drained on a staggered schedule to avoid simultaneous cache purges that would spike downstream access patterns. 4) Safe rollout and flags: all behavior behind a feature flag toggled per-region and per-tenant; canary in us-west-2. 5) Observability & tracing: new metrics (tenant_quarantine_state, tenant_admission_reject_rate, kv_drain_progress) plus trace tags for quarantine decisions. Implementation notes: admission hook inserted in routing layer, policy stored in tenant catalog, lease allocator added to control-plane service (leadership-guarded), and admission probability calibrated using recent percentiles and a configurable aggressiveness parameter. Tests & checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in description - [x] Unit tests for admission probability, edge cases - [x] Integration tests for lease lifecycle and leadership failover - [x] E2E chaos test exercising node eviction while quarantines active - [x] Observability: dashboards and alerts added - [x] Feature flag gating for canary rollout - [x] Ops runbook and roll-back instructions. Rollout plan: enable in staging, canary in us-west-2 at 5% tenant traffic (72h observation), expand to additional regions in controlled steps, automatic rollback if 95th token latency increases by >1% or error-rate delta exceeds configured threshold. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is no-op unless feature flag enabled; no schema changes to persisted models. See commits and files changed for concrete diffs.

review_comments: Anya Koval (reviewer): Please add a safety cap to the admission probability to avoid rejecting >50% of requests for high-priority tenants.
Author (Priya Rao): Added a priority-exempt threshold and maximum reject cap (see tenant_admission.rs).
Diego Martinez (reviewer): Lease coordination looks racy when leader flips during issuance. Can we persist a pending-lease marker to avoid double-quarantine?
Author (Priya Rao): Reworked allocator to write a short-lived pending marker to raft-backed store; added integration test for leader failover.
Ethan Zhao (reviewer): Add more granular metrics for monitoring KV drain contention — required for SRE dashboard.
Author (Priya Rao): Added kv_drain_progress and kv_drain_batch_size metrics and updated dashboards; responded with screenshots in the doc.
ci_checks: ci/integration-tests: pass (1 rerun due to flake)
testing_notes: Unit tests cover admission probability edge cases and priority exemptions. Integration tests simulate leader failover while leases are active. E2E chaos test evicted a node while quarantines were active to validate that degraded traffic remains isolated and cluster SLOs stay within tolerance. Load testing with synthetic tenants showed a 3-7x reduction in cross-tenant noisy neighbor incidents on spike scenarios.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag in staging; 2) Canary: us-west-2 at 5% tenant traffic for 72h; monitor tenant_admission_reject_rate, 95th token latency, error rate; 3) Gradual expansion to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with 50% steps over 24h windows; 4) Full enable across regions if no regressions; Automated rollback triggers: +1% 95th token latency or >0.5% absolute error-rate increase versus baseline.
notes: This is a runtime-forward change that is feature-flag gated. Ops team to coordinate canary window and observe kv_drain_progress panel for any unexpected churn.
